title: Eco Green Solar CMS v2.4.6
features: ⚡ Product-Specific Duplicate Check: Duplicate complaint detection now verifies both customer and product type.
🛡️ Multi-Product Support: Customers with an open ticket for one product (e.g. Solar Rooftop) can now register tickets for other products (e.g. Solar Water Heater) without being blocked.
🔄 Real-time Form Updates: Switching product in complaint modal automatically refreshes active ticket status.
